
    Evaluate the medical consultation transcript for {station_name}.

    Transcript speakers are tagged DOCTOR (GP trainee under assessment) and PATIENT (simulated patient).

    For each category in the assessment framework:
    1. Assign appropriate scores based on the scoring system defined
    2. Support with direct quotes from transcript (grammatically corrected)
    3. Be specific and evidence-based
    4. Identify what was done well and what was missed
    5. Provide actionable improvement suggestions

    {transcript}

    Note: Every field requires both score and supporting evidence from the transcript.
